name: Lido Nation
description_short: Blockchain education, tools, and community building.
description_long: Blockchain education, outreach, and global community building on Cardano. Publishes a multilingual library of explainers, insights, and news in six languages, produces the Lido Minute podcast, and runs the LIDO stake pool with an Every Epoch learn-and-earn rewards program. Also builds ecosystem tools, most notably Catalyst Explorer — a full explorer for Project Catalyst proposals, funding rounds, reviewers, and charts — plus a Cardano protocol parameter explorer and a community bazaar.
